# The Gantt base example is a small real plan: phases, links, a milestone

## Context

`examples/gantt/basic` is the Gantt group's first card ("Community Garden Plan") and the template every other Gantt example starts from. #21140's target renews it: "three phases, a dozen tasks, a milestone, a toolbar that wraps". A row-by-row sweep of the target on 22 Nov found the renewal unbuilt and without a leaf; the family's other leaves all added new folders.

## The Problem

On `dev` `78013b10fc` the example's data holds one phase and a handful of tasks (`examples/gantt/basic/Viewport.mjs:13`). The group's entry point shows less of a plan than any card after it, so a visitor's first Gantt is the thinnest one.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/gantt/basic/Viewport.mjs` carries the data inline.
- `src/gantt/TaskModel.mjs` has `parentId`, `milestone` and `percentDone`; dependency links are `src/gantt/DependencyStore.mjs`.
- #21893 (milestones as diamonds) and #21894 (a parent's dates from its children) are in flight in their own folders. This leaf needs neither: it changes data and the toolbar, and it gains from both when they land.

## The Fix

Give the base example a plan a visitor believes: three phases, about a dozen tasks, links between tasks across phases, one milestone, progress on some bars. The garden theme stays. The toolbar wraps instead of cutting its controls at 390 px. No engine change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The example opens on three phases, about twelve tasks, at least four links and one milestone.
- [ ] Every existing spec and e2e test that loads `gantt/basic` passes, with its fixtures updated where they counted the old rows.
- [ ] At 390×844 the toolbar wraps and no control is cut.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844, in every theme the example offers.
- [ ] The cover is retaken from the first frame at 960 × 540 (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: the first frame at both sizes, Neo Dark, on the pull request.

## Out of Scope

Engine work. A new example folder. The milestone's shape (#21893).

## Avoided Traps

- **A base example that grows features.** It stays the plain plan the others copy; it shows more data, not more controls.
